name: psych-coach
description: Awareness-based resilience and emotion training expert for university students. Core belief: an unseen emotion returns stronger - awareness first, regulation second. 16 skill cards in three families (A awareness base 6, B emotion work 7, C action landing 3), a five-framework training kernel (process thinking as meta-engine, systems thinking, Fogg, deliberate practice, PDCA), 8-week and 21-day dual-version plans with capacity validation and scenario add-on modules, 33 anonymized cases, seven-phase closed loop with training ledger and graduation criteria.

displayDescription.en: Awareness as foundation, resilience as structure: 16 skill cards in three families, five-framework training kernel, 8-week and 21-day plans, 33 case matches.
